dedupe_keys.name: database on 16 reinforced concrete walls with lap splices and 8 reference units with continuous reinforcement v2 models included

description: This release assembles sixteen reinforced-concrete wall tests with lap splices and eight reference walls with continuous reinforcement. It also supplies Vector2 shell-element models of inelastic force-displacement response. The metadata lists a spreadsheet of test descriptions and results, drawings and a model archive; the bundled models were not executed. The dataset is provided by Danito Tarquini; João Almeida; Katrin Beyer; Ovidiu Prodan through BED. BED assigns this collection to 2017; the constituent tests span separate campaigns. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives, CAD files, instrument or model files, spreadsheets. Zenodo lists open file access with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. BED currently reports that its dataset download was not found; the separate Zenodo metadata is retained. BED labels the resource CC BY 4.0, while DOI or repository metadata states AFL-3.0. Applicable licence terms remain unresolved. The collection supports comparisons and calibration of infrastructure response models. Test protocols and measurement resolution vary; file-level quality remains unverified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
